name: jus
description: Read and change your Juscribe board, and work its tickets the way your team does. One install brings the Juscribe connector and three skills that carry the board's rules: ticket-workflow (the ticket lifecycle, estimation, labels, testing gates and the jus API reference), hard-rules (what never to do on a board) and retrospective (reviewing an iteration). In Claude Code and Cowork it adds enforcement hooks, which do nothing where the jus command is not installed.
